resources.string: Counts use the selected boards, entries and manual tags. Mana values come from the source once per copy. Known-value averages show their own denominators; missing facts remain unknown.

These are reported possibilities, not guaranteed usable mana. Restrictions, activation costs and simultaneous output are not inferred. %1$d known-land copies lack reported production; unresolved types may hide more sources.
Cards may have multiple tags. Overlapping tag totals do not add to physical deck size.
